archetypes.name: dyn-glm-pricing
archetypes.rationale: GLM alias and plan-divisor paths are easy to mis-wire across main vs subprocess lanes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect GLM-5.2 rate-row completeness, main-agent-only canonicalize_glm_main_model usage, and that rate_row/_claude_sub_rates_for_model do not gain the alias. Confirm final-summary TOTAL substitutes only the main Claude component with T/15 and that non-GLM and claude_sub paths stay byte-stable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
